public_note: This Weber B139 package was found in the Weber restart lane after Batch138. It is a focused off-ledger equation-tag repair and heuristic-rule addition, not a new broad section-range completion and not a critical edition.

files.quality_label: Weber B139 focused off-ledger Volume II English section 49 merged-tag repair
files.coverage: Package status reports one off-ledger defect closed: Volume II English section 49 had equations (5) and (6) collapsed into one display tagged `5--6`; B139 splits that into source-aligned equations (5) and (6). The active 112-row ledger remains 112/112 closed and 0/112 open. The package includes patched German/English section 49 slices, cumulative Volume II TeX/PDF, source scan slice/renders for Vol. II section 49 pp.189-190, render checks, page ledger, heuristic scan/logbook, manifest, and SHA256 sums.
files.findings: New/refined recursive error family: merged range equation tags such as `\tag{5--6}` can hide missing display structure even when the mathematics is mostly present. B139 adds the rule to scan cumulative TeX for `\tag{m--n}` and treat each hit as a source-check target before changing anything.
files.limitations: This is a working/source-witnessed repair-ledger package, not a certified critical edition. German section 49 and the source scan already split the displays; the promoted B139 action is the English split and the heuristic rule. Remaining range tags in Volume I/III are logged as off-ledger source-check targets rather than changed without source confirmation.
